description:
The blueprints: whole backends for a named kind of business, each a
set of English definitions proven on this platform. Ask with the
purpose in the customer's words, such as "salon appointments with a
deposit", before you define the first entity of a new backend. A
blueprint that fits is started with start_from_blueprint, and every
definition in it is the customer's own to change afterwards.

purpose.description: What the backend is for, in the customer's words. Leave it out to list every blueprint.

name: list_blueprints

answer.description: The matching blueprints, one paragraph each, in English.
